full_text:
Article 7 (Secretary)
(1) The Strategy Meeting shall have one secretary to handle its administrative affairs, who shall be the Second Vice Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism. <Amended on November 5, 2019>
(2) The secretary shall prepare minutes of the meetings.
